name: Greece
note: Inventions with a recorded country of origin in Wikidata, topped up from the English Wikipedia's per-country invention list articles (CC BY-SA). Every entry passed a Wikidata class check (device, technology, process, product, software, medication ...); diseases, species, discoveries, theorems and food are excluded by ruling. Dates are recorded or parsed from prose and are often approximate.

inventions.name: Archimedes' heat ray
inventions.description: Archimedes is purported to have invented a large scale solar furnace, sometimes described as a heat ray, and used it to burn attacking Roman ships during the Siege of Syracuse.

inventions.name: Astrolabe
inventions.description: An astrolabe is an astronomical instrument dating to ancient times.

inventions.name: Baglamas

inventions.name: Bouzouki
inventions.description: The bouzouki is a musical instrument popular in Greece.

inventions.name: Kithara
inventions.description: The kithara, Latinized as cithara, was an ancient Greek musical instrument in the yoke lutes family.

inventions.name: Crane (machine)
inventions.description: A crane is a machine used to move materials both vertically and horizontally, utilizing a system of a boom, hoist, wire ropes or chains, and sheaves for lifting and relocating heavy objects within the swing of its boom.

image.author: Wilfredo R. Rodriguez H. edited by Gregory David Harington

inventions.name: Differential (mechanical device)
inventions.description: A differential is a gear train with three drive shafts that has the property that the rotational speed of one shaft is the average of the speeds of the others.

inventions.name: Fire pump
inventions.description: A fire pump usually refers to a pressure-increasing component of the water supply for fixed-place fire suppression systems such as fire sprinklers, standpipes, and foam systems.

inventions.name: Headband
inventions.description: A headband is a clothing accessory worn in the hair or around the forehead, usually to hold hair away from the face or eyes, or to help control forehead sweat or (rarely) to provide some protection to the head during…

inventions.name: Sponge (tool)
inventions.description: A sponge is a cleaning aid made of soft, porous material.

inventions.name: Syringe
inventions.description: A syringe is a simple reciprocating pump consisting of a plunger that fits tightly within a cylindrical tube called a barrel.

inventions.name: Thermometer
inventions.description: A thermometer is a device that measures temperature.
